content.text: Root cause: `hideOverlay` and `forceHideOverlay` were `local function` declarations at line ~922, *after* `createOverlay`. Lua captures upvalues at definition time, so the mouse callback inside `createOverlay` captured `nil` for `hideOverlay`. Fixed by forward-declaring both as `local` variables before `createOverlay`, then assigning their bodies at the original location (same pattern already used for `PL` in this file).
